capabilities: delete empty folders inside configurable attachment directories
scan targeted directories when notes or attachments are deleted
clean up automatically on startup or on a schedule
choose system trash, .trash folder, or permanent deletion
trigger cleanup manually via command or settings button
extras: README is bilingual English/Chinese and includes a preview section; the plugin notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; mobile uses the .trash folder for deletions instead of system trash.
problem: Deleting notes or attachments in Obsidian leaves piles of empty folders in attachment directories that Obsidian itself never cleans up.
summary: Cleanup utility that removes empty folders left behind in attachment directories after notes or attachments are deleted.
